svg.title: Inside the Dueline app
svg.desc: The layers of the app from top to bottom: screens, the typed api-client, the proxy that checks the signed demo cookie, route handlers that validate every request, the modules in src/lib grouped by job, and the store, which is Postgres or memory. Outside systems sit on the right: PayPal, Gemini, ECB rates and Postgres. In offline mode a fake PayPal, a small parser and templates, saved rates and the in-memory store replace them. The animation walks one request down the layers to PayPal and the store, then back up to the screen.
svg.text: One request, from a screen down to PayPal and the store, and back.
Client components: Home, Clients, New invoice, Nudges, Export, Fees and rates, Profile
src/lib/api-client.ts: one typed function per endpoint, the only way to the server
src/proxy.ts: checks the signed demo cookie, no database or PayPal call
src/app/api: zod on every body, one { error: { code, message } } shape
Modules in src/lib, grouped by job
One interface: Postgres, or memory when no database is set
One switch swaps the four systems
below for code inside the app:
The checks and the routes do not change.

g.text: A screen calls a typed function in api-client
The call goes to the server as JSON over HTTPS
The proxy checks the signed cookie and lets the request through
The route validates the body and hands the work to a module
The module asks PayPal, Gemini or the rate service
It reads or writes the store, which is Postgres or memory
The answer climbs back, checked in code, as { ok } or { error }
api-client turns it into data or an error, and the screen draws it
